name: Tinda Masala
ingredients: 300 g tinda (apple gourd), peeled and quartered
½ tsp each cumin seeds and fennel seeds
½ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric and ½ tsp chilli powder
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the cumin and fennel seeds. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes into a thick masala.
Add the tinda and ¼ cup water, cover and cook for 10 minutes until just tender.
Add the chickpeas and cook uncovered for 3 minutes.
Finish with amchur, salt and coriander.
note: Chickpeas turn a light gourd side dish into a more filling meal.

inspirationReferences.title: Khatti Meethi Tinda Masala Recipe
inspirationReferences.note: A North Indian one-pot tinda preparation using ajwain, ginger, tomato, green chilli, amchur and kasuri methi. It informed the sour-spice profile and pressure-cooking approach; the Kitchen recipe's measured ingredients and protein adaptation remain original.
